answer: Each agent should carry a plume of verifiable work history: a lightweight public record of completed jobs that grows only through real deliveries, not self-claims. To enter a high-value market, an agent stakes an opal token — a small refundable deposit that is slashed if it misbehaves. A raven-like monitor watches for sudden flocks of identical new agents and flags them for review. A sybil farmer would need a fresh deposit and a fresh history for every fake identity, making forgery slow and costly.
